# Calculatorship.in
> Independent, free Indian personal finance calculators and plain-English educational guides for salaried professionals and retail investors.

Calculatorship is an independent financial calculation and educational publishing project built by Tejas Waghmare, a student and web developer in India. He is not a SEBI-registered investment adviser, research analyst, or Chartered Accountant. Every tool uses standard Indian financial formulas (reducing-balance EMI, quarterly-compounded bank deposits, statutory EPF/PPF/Gratuity rules, and FY 2026-27 Indian income tax slabs) with worked Rupee (INR) examples cross-checked against official RBI, SEBI, EPFO, and Income Tax Department notifications.

## Core Financial Calculators (Clean Canonical URLs)

- [SIP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/): Systematic Investment Plan compounding calculator with annual growth tables and equity capital gains notes.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/lumpsum): One-time mutual fund compounding calculator with year-by-year accumulation breakdown.
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/step-up): Top-up SIP calculator modeling annual contribution increases alongside salary hikes.
- [Goal Planner Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/goal): Reverse SIP calculator to find the monthly savings needed for an inflation-adjusted target corpus.
- [Stock Average Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/stock-average-calculator-guide-india): Weighted average share buy price, target average share count, and break-even move calculator for Indian equity delivery trades.
- [PPF Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/ppf-calculator): Public Provident Fund calculator at 7.1% p.a. with 5th-of-the-month rules and 15-to-30-year schedules.
- [EPF Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/epf-calculator): Employee Provident Fund calculator at 8.25% p.a. with employee, employer, and EPS splits.
- [NPS Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/nps-calculator): National Pension System retirement corpus estimator with lump-sum vs annuity splits.
- [SWP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/swp-calculator): Systematic Withdrawal Plan simulator for monthly post-retirement cash flows.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/emi-calculator): Reducing-balance home, car, and personal loan amortization and prepayment impact calculator.
- [SGB Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/sgb-calculator): Sovereign Gold Bond 2.50% coupon, Budget 2026 Section 70 tax rules, and Gold ETF comparison.
- [Cumulative FD Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/cumulative-fd-calculator): Cumulative and payout FD maturity with monthly/quarterly projections and ₹50K–₹1Cr table.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/fd-calculator): Cumulative and payout Fixed Deposit maturity calculator with Indian quarterly compounding.
- [RD Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/recurring-deposit-rd-calculator-guide-india): Recurring Deposit maturity calculator following Indian bank quarterly compounding formulas.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/income-tax-calculator): Side-by-side Old vs New Tax Regime calculator for FY 2026-27 with Section 87A rebate and marginal relief.
- [In-Hand Salary Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/in-hand-salary-calculator): CTC to monthly in-hand take-home pay breakdown covering PF, gratuity, professional tax, and TDS.
- [HRA Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/hra-calculator): House Rent Allowance exemption calculator under Section 10(13A) and Rule 2A.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/gratuity-calculator): Payment of Gratuity Act (15/26 formula) calculator with statutory tax exemption rules.
- [GST Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/gst-calculator): GST-inclusive and GST-exclusive calculator with CGST, SGST, and IGST splits.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/cagr-calculator): Compound Annual Growth Rate and reverse future-value calculator.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/compound-interest-calculator): Daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual compounding calculator in INR.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/simple-interest-calculator): Straightforward simple interest calculator for short-term loans and notes.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/inflation-calculator): Purchasing power and future cost calculator using Indian CPI inflation rates.
- [50/30/20 Budget Planner](https://www.calculatorship.in/budget-planner): Monthly take-home pay split across Needs, Wants, and Savings.
- [8th Pay Commission Salary Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/8th-pay-commission-salary-calculator-fitment-factor): Fitment factor pay matrix estimator for central government employees.
